turns.text: As always, I've gone to the trouble of grinding down the serial number.
turns.zh: 跟往常一样，我费了点功夫把序列号磨掉了。

turns.text: Now, unless you grind the hole clean through, acid will recover it.
turns.zh: 不过，除非你把那个洞彻底磨穿，否则酸液还是能把它显出来。

turns.text: Well, that would be true, but I follow up with a pass through a random stipple machine press.
turns.zh: 嗯，那倒是没错，但我后面还会用随机点刻机压一遍。

turns.text: Hides the patterns in the metal density.
turns.zh: 把纹路藏进金属密度里。

turns.text: Should throw off your x-ray diffraction and some other higher end methods.
turns.zh: 应该能干扰你的X射线衍射，还有一些更高端的检测方法。

turns.text: Nothing's perfect, of course, but this is close.
turns.zh: 当然，没有什么是完美的，但这个已经很接近了。

turns.text: Looks like a hernia with a scope on it.
turns.zh: 看起来像个带瞄准镜的疝气。
